nodes.label: Email Verification Screen Image
nodes.description: A motivational photograph showing multiple fists from diverse individuals stacked vertically in a group fist-bump gesture against a bright, light blue sky background. The image conveys solidarity, teamwork, collective commitment, and shared purpose. Emotionally it projects energy, determination, and community belonging. Used as the hero/background image for the email verification screen in the IFit app, likely intended to reinforce the user's decision to join the platform and encourage completion of the verification step with a sense of collective motivation and trust.
nodes.design_purpose: Hero background image for the VerificationView screen; communicates community, solidarity, and motivational energy to users completing the email verification step during registration
